verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is a single thin claim that agents can be brought to life 'through a web or mobile app'. That implies client support across web and mobile, and a community user confirms it worked with Svelte on the web. missing for 10: explicit official iOS and Android SDK documentation, evidence of a shared session/room and track model across platforms, confirmation that one backend serves all clients, independent corroboration on mobile.

support.subject: As a developer, official client SDKs cover web, iOS, and Android with the same session and track model, so one backend serves every platform

citations.quote: Bring your agent to life through a web or mobile app.
